nodes.description: Address state variable 'governance' in ERC20; controls who may call the privileged mint-capable function transferFromAndCall.
Boolean flag in TetrisFinance gating token transfers via the canTransfer modifier.
Mapping of account balances updated in _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Total token supply, increased in _mint and decreased in _burn.
Immutable maximum supply enforced in ERC20Capped._beforeTokenTransfer.
Owner address in Ownable, used by the onlyOwner access check.
TetrisFinance constructor; sets decimals, cap and initializes ERC20/ERC1363/Roles modules.
ERC20 constructor which writes governance = tx.origin, tying privilege to the transaction originator.
Public ERC20 function that mints arbitrary tokens when msg.sender == governance.
TetrisFinance.transfer overridden with the canTransfer modifier.
TetrisFinance.transferFrom overridden with the canTransfer modifier.
Internal ERC20 balance transfer updating _balances.
Internal ERC20 minting function increasing total supply and recipient balance.
Internal ERC20 burn function decreasing balance and total supply.
Hook overridden by ERC20Capped to enforce the supply cap on minting.
Modifier requiring _transferEnabled or OPERATOR_ROLE for the sender.
TokenRecover.recoverERC20, onlyOwner, pulls arbitrary ERC20 tokens out of the contract.
Ownable.owner view returning the _owner state variable.
ERC1363 transfer-and-callback entry point; performs transfer then invokes external receiver callback.
Internal ERC1363 helper calling onTransferReceived on the recipient contract.
Address.sendValue library function performing a low-level call forwarding all gas.
msg.sender, external caller-controlled input used for authorization checks.
tx.origin, transaction originator used to set the governance address.
Unsafe assignment governance = tx.origin, enabling phishing-based privilege takeover.
Unrestricted _mint invocation in transferFromAndCall, guarded only by a tx.origin-derived address.
recipient.call{value: amount}("") forwards all gas before state is finalized, reentrancy risk.
External call to IERC1363Receiver.onTransferReceived on a user-supplied contract address.
External IERC20(tokenAddress).transfer call on an arbitrary token address.
Parameter fromAddress of ERC20.transferFromAndCall, the mint recipient.
Parameter SubstractedValue of ERC20.transferFromAndCall, the minted amount.
Parameter to of ERC1363.transferAndCallData, the callback target.
Parameter value of ERC1363.transferAndCallData, the transferred amount.
Parameter tokenAddress of recoverERC20, arbitrary token contract.
Parameter tokenAmount of recoverERC20, amount pulled from the contract.
Local bytes4 retval returned by the ERC1363 receiver callback.
Local bool success returned by the low-level call in sendValue.

edges.reason: ERC20 constructor reads tx.origin to derive the privileged governance account.
ERC20 constructor executes the governance = tx.origin assignment.
tx.origin flows directly into the unsafe governance assignment.
The unsafe tx.origin assignment writes the governance state variable.
governance is compared against msg.sender inside transferFromAndCall.
msg.sender is the sole authorization check in transferFromAndCall.
transferFromAndCall reaches the unrestricted minting operation after authorization.
fromAddress parameter is passed into the minting flow of transferFromAndCall.
SubstractedValue parameter is passed into the minting flow of transferFromAndCall.
Attacker-controlled SubstractedValue determines the minted amount, affecting total supply.
The unsafe mint operation invokes ERC20._mint.
_mint increases _totalSupply through SafeMath addition.
_mint credits the recipient entry of _balances.
_transferEnabled gates the canTransfer modifier used for transfer authorization.
msg.sender address is evaluated for OPERATOR_ROLE inside canTransfer.
canTransfer modifier guards the overridden transfer function.
canTransfer modifier guards the overridden transferFrom function.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
_transfer updates the _balances mapping for sender and recipient.
TetrisFinance constructor chains into the ERC20 constructor.
_burn invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
ERC20Capped._beforeTokenTransfer compares totalSupply().add(amount) against _cap.
transferAndCallData calls _checkAndCallTransfer which performs the external callback.
Control is handed to an untrusted recipient contract via onTransferReceived.
The untrusted receiver callback returns control to the token contract mid-operation.
Destination parameter to determines which contract receives the callback.
Local retval holds the magic value returned by the untrusted callback.
msg.sender is used as the operator argument passed to the receiver callback.
sendValue performs the low-level value call to the recipient.
The recipient can re-enter during the value transfer before the success check completes.
Local success flag is derived from the low-level call result in sendValue.
recoverERC20 authorization depends on msg.sender matching the owner via onlyOwner.
recoverERC20 calls owner() to determine the token transfer destination.
owner() returns the _owner state variable used by the onlyOwner check.
recoverERC20 performs an external token transfer on a caller-supplied token contract.
tokenAddress parameter selects the arbitrary token contract to drain.
tokenAmount parameter sets the amount transferred out by recoverERC20.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter belongs to the ERC20.transferFromAndCall mint entry point and should be folded into that core function node.
Parameter supplies the mint amount for the privileged transferFromAndCall function and should merge into it.
Parameter selects the ERC1363 callback target for transferAndCallData and should be absorbed by that function node.
Parameter carries the transferred amount for transferAndCallData and should be absorbed by that function node.
Parameter is the arbitrary token target of recoverERC20 and should merge into that core function node.
Parameter is the drained amount in recoverERC20 and should merge into that core function node.
Local retval only stores the magic value of the ERC1363 callback inside _checkAndCallTransfer.
Local success only stores the low-level call result inside the Address.sendValue function.
